visualCharacteristics.structure: background image + looping background video with overlay; H1, intro paragraph, 2 CTAs, row of 4 platform link tiles
visualCharacteristics.sectionStyle: dark (background image + looping video with dark overlay, white text)
visualCharacteristics.summary: Background image with background video overlay; large H1 with highlighted words, intro paragraph, two CTA links (primary 'Start a Conversation', secondary 'Explore the Work'), row of four platform link tiles each with bold title and short description

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = background image plus an optional link to an .mp4 video (same or second cell); row 2 = H1, intro paragraph, CTA links (bold = primary, italic = secondary), and a bulleted list where each item is a link with a bold title followed by a short description (rendered as platform tiles)
